title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Lunar Expansion: NASA has officially unveiled a multi-phase roadmap for a permanent human presence at the Moon's South Pole, awarding contracts for Lunar Terrain Vehicles to Astrolab and Lunar Outpost while preparing for the Artemis III crew announcement.

AI Geopolitics: China is treating top AI professionals as strategic national infrastructure, implementing travel restrictions to secure the human capital necessary for frontier-adjacent model development under hardware constraints.

Market Milestones: Micron has surpassed a $1 trillion market cap following a record 20% gain, and the US Space Force has awarded SpaceX a $2.29 billion contract for a military data network, signaling continued convergence between tech and defense.

Agentic Progress: The AI ecosystem is shifting toward agentic workflows with the release of the DeepSWE benchmark for coding agents, GPT-5.5 integration into developer tools, and a focus on sandboxed agent safety.

Policy & Regulation: A new Trump administration proposal requiring green-card applicants to leave the U.S. before applying is set to disrupt legal migration pathways, while NYC mayoral proposals regarding landlord-to-community property transfers spark intense debate.

items.title: @_The_Prophet__: China's Strategic Talent Lockdown
items.body: China is restricting overseas travel for top AI professionals, treating human talent as "strategic human infrastructure" vital for sovereign war architecture. This move emphasizes the value of tacit know-how in extracting performance from limited compute resources.

items.title: @OpenAIDevs: GPT-5.5 Integration in Codex
items.body: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.5 capabilities into Codex, currently being utilized by Databricks to handle complex customer document parsing with improved reliability. The update suggests a significant leap in the reasoning and extraction capabilities of developer-focused models.

items.title: @AnthropicAI: AI Agent Sandboxing and Safety
items.body: Anthropic's engineering team has highlighted the importance of evolving agent permissions via sandboxing to limit the scope of destructive actions as capabilities grow. This reflects a broader industry trend toward "safe agency" where models interact with tools in protected environments.

items.title: @ClaudeCodeLog: Claude Code v2.1.152 Release
items.body: The latest update to the Claude Code CLI introduces automated code review fixes and the ability to disable specific tools during active sessions to prevent accidental execution. These features aim to further automate the "Plan-Act-Validate" cycle for autonomous development.

items.title: @steipete: DeepSWE Agentic Coding Benchmark
items.body: DeepSWE has been released as a new standard for benchmarking agentic coding models, addressing the issue of top models appearing similar by introducing more challenging, real-world edge cases. It aims to provide a more rigorous evaluation than existing public leaderboards.

items.title: @Google: Gemini Neural Expressive and AI Inbox
items.body: Google I/O updates reveal a new "Neural Expressive" design language for Gemini and an "AI Inbox" for Gmail that generates personalized draft replies and surfaces relevant documents. These updates focus on integrating LLMs directly into productivity workflows through proactive task management.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: US Space Force $2.29B SpaceX Contract
items.body: The US Space Force has awarded SpaceX a multi-billion dollar contract to develop a space-based military data network, reinforcing the company's position as a primary defense contractor. This follows clarifications that the Department of War views SpaceX as a valued and effective partner.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Micron Surpasses $1T Market Cap
items.body: Micron technology reached a historic $1 trillion market cap milestone following its largest one-day gain since 2011. The surge reflects intense market demand for high-bandwidth memory essential for scaling next-generation AI infrastructure.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Trump's Bitcoin and AI Board Appointments
items.body: President Trump stated he will protect the US position as the "Bitcoin capital of the world" and has appointed former AG Pam Bondi to the White House AI board. These moves signal a dual focus on maintaining crypto dominance and increasing political oversight of AI development.

items.title: @TheEconomist: Green Card Application Policy Shift
items.body: A new Trump administration policy may require green-card applicants to leave the U.S. before applying, a move expected to significantly slow legal migration. Critics warn this could cause widespread disruption for workers and families currently in the process.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: American Airlines Partners with Starlink
items.body: American Airlines shares rose 7% following the announcement that it will equip its fleet with Elon Musk’s Starlink service. This continues SpaceX's rapid expansion into the commercial aviation sector, with 38 airlines now partnered for high-speed connectivity.

items.title: @NASA: NASA's Permanent Moon Base Roadmap
items.body: NASA has officially unveiled a master plan for a permanent human outpost at the lunar South Pole, relying heavily on commercial innovators like SpaceX and Lunar Outpost. The base is designed as a proving ground for future Mars missions, featuring fission power and robotic infrastructure.

items.title: @NASA: Artemis III Astronaut Selection June 9
items.body: NASA will announce the four-person crew for the Artemis III mission on June 9, who will be tasked with testing docking capabilities for future crewed Moon landings. This mission represents a critical step in the return to the lunar surface.

items.title: @elonmusk: NYC Property Ownership Transfer Controversy
items.body: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani has proposed a plan to transfer property ownership from "bad landlords" to non-profits and community groups. The proposal has sparked intense debate over property rights and urban housing policy.

items.title: @RealKidPoker: WSOP 2026 Kickoff in Las Vegas
items.body: The World Series of Poker has begun its 51-day run at the Horseshoe and Paris Las Vegas, featuring 100 bracelet events and expanded live streaming coverage. This year introduces a massive new production stage and wall-to-wall digital broadcasting.

items.title: @wangdan1989: Chinese Parliament Voter Registration
items.body: Overseas democratic activists have launched a registration platform for a "Chinese Parliament (Temporary)," aiming to introduce the concept of voting and public political participation to Chinese citizens. The initiative offers "Founding Voter Certificates" to participants globally.
